title: staged-triage-gateway-and-oncall-rate-limiter
author: Arjun Patel
release_notes: Adds a staged triage gateway with configurable quiet-hours throttling and a token-aware oncall rate limiter. Backwards compatible; feature gated behind incident_bot.feature.staged_trige_gateway flag.
description: Context: On high-volume incidents we see responder noise and duplicated triage work when many automated probes, integrations, and external alerting sources hit the incident-bot at once. This PR introduces a staged triage gateway that batches and sequences incoming incident creation/triage requests into an 'incident funnel' and pairs it with an oncall-aware rate limiter that respects quiet-hours and responder capacity policies. Motivation: reduce noisy duplicated pages, prevent responder overload during blackouts/quiet windows, and give SRE teams a tunable backpressure mechanism that integrates with existing runbook routing. Design summary: 1) staged-triage-gateway: lightweight HTTP endpoint that validates incoming payloads, attaches provenance metadata, and enqueues triage tasks into a multi-priority queue. The queue implements short-lived temporal buckets to preserve ordering from the same source while smoothing burst traffic. 2) oncall-rate-limiter: a token-bucket variant keyed by rotation-id + priority that enforces capacity budgets and quiet-hours multipliers. Tokens are replenished based on configured cadence and can be temporarily borrowed for critical pages (override flag). 3) Policy service hooks: gateway queries the existing oncall roster service (cached for 30s) to decide throttling multipliers and escalation windowing. 4) Observability: new.metrics.incident_funnel.* and histogram for time-in-funnel, plus tracing spans for enqueue/dequeue/dispatch. 5) Rollout: feature flag gated, default disabled; staged rollout to non-prod then paired with synthetic load test and small dogfood org before global enable. Implementation notes: implemented in Go (existing incident-bot service), uses jobrunner queue abstraction (extended with temporal buckets), introduces a lightweight policy cache, and adds a new middleware for provenance enrichment. Backwards compatibility: existing webhook contract unchanged; gateway accepts same payload and will forward immediately if the feature flag is off or if the payload is marked urgent. Testing and validation: unit tests for queue semantics, integration tests against a local roster mock, a small perf harness to validate latency under bursts, and playground policy configs for operators. Checklist: - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration tests for policy cache - [x] e2e harness simulating 10k events/min - [x] metrics and dashboards created - [x] feature flag and migration docs - [x] sample policy config and runbook notes Limitations and next steps: currently supports only rotation-id based budgeting; future work will add team-level aggregate budgets, rate-limit fallbacks to alternate escalation channels, and automated suggestions to reduce duplicate alerts.

review_comments: Sofia Lopez: Nice approach. Can we make the queue bucket duration configurable per source? In some cases 2s is too coarse and in others 30s is required.
Arjun Patel: Good point. Added per-source bucket_duration_ms with a safe default of 5000ms; documented tradeoffs in the operator guide.
Evan Brooks: The token borrowing path looks potentially dangerous — who can mark an event borrowable? We should restrict to automated critical-sources only.
Arjun Patel: Implemented allow_borrow boolean in policy config and added validation to reject user-supplied override unless source is listed as critical in policies. Added unit tests.
Maya Chen: CI flake on the perf harness — observed a timeout in the integration job. Can we increase the timeout and make the harness idempotent?
Arjun Patel: Increased CI timeout for the perf job, made the harness cleanup idempotent, and reran the job (now passes).
Sofia Lopez: Approving after verifying metrics look sane in the dogfood org (reduction in duplicate pages ~37%).
Evan Brooks: Rebased and verified linter warnings fixed. Approving.
ci_log_summary: Integration: pass after roster mock fixes; Unit: pass; Lint: pass (minor reformat); Perf job: pass (timeout increased); E2E: pass in dogfood org
notes_for_ops: Feature gated. To enable: flip incident_bot.feature.staged_trige_gateway=true and apply policies in config/policies/example_staged_policy.yaml. Recommended starting policy sets capacity_multiplier=0.6 for quiet-hours and bucket_duration_ms=5000. Monitor new.metrics.incident_funnel.time_in_funnel and dashboards/incident_funnel.json for anomalies.
